name: Quéguiner Matériaux
verdict: The materials arm of the Breton Groupe Quéguiner, a family construction-materials group founded in 1948 at Landivisiau and chaired by Clément Quéguiner; the club's front-of-shirt sponsor since 2000. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: registry shows the Quéguiner family filling the holding's governance (Clément Quéguiner Président de SAS, Bertrand and Claude Quéguinaire Directeurs Généraux). No state or fund stake found → none.
